gr-001: “Sit. I am told you can keep a secret and still tell the truth. Show me how, before the council convenes.”
gr-002: “Mind the third step; it remembers every foot. You came here alive. That is rarer than courage. State your errand.”
gr-003: “Do not tell me which world I belong to. Everyone does. Tell me what you notice when I walk through the door.”
gr-004: “Take an oar. If anyone asks, we are traders from Crete. You will find the story gets better every time I tell it.”
gr-005: “Look at the floor. I will not ask twice, and I will not be offended. Now: what did the stories say about me before you came?”
gr-006: “Quick, hold this and do not open it. Fine, open it, everyone does. Now tell me whose handwriting that is.”
gr-007: “Walk where I walk. Breathe slower. If the deer bolts, it is your fault, and I will tell the whole forest.”
gr-008: “Careful, the chains are cold today. You brought flint, did you? Good. Then we have something to talk about.”
no-001: “Sit, wanderer. Two ravens told me you were coming; they usually lie. Ask me something I have not already answered.”
no-002: “Do not look so worried. I only borrowed it. Admittedly from a dwarf, a giant, and one very angry goddess. Care to help me return it?”
no-003: “Hah! A guest! Sit by the fire. No, the hammer does not bite. Tell me, do you know any songs that are not about me?”
no-004: “Come closer, mortal. I collect brave things and kind things. Tell me which one you are before I decide.”
no-005: “The door only opens inward. Remember that. You will have questions. The dead will answer if you ask them politely.”
no-006: “Keep up or turn back. The pass does not care about your feelings. I will not either, but I will wait at the bend.”
no-007: “I will answer one question truthfully before the trial begins. Choose it with care. I have only one hand to give for the next.”
no-008: “You crossed the fire. Either you are a hero or a fool. Tell me which, then tell me why you are laughing.”
tr-001: “Oh good, you are here! I was about to walk off the edge without telling anyone. Shall we go together?”
tr-002: “Watch my left hand. No, the right. Now tell me what you saw, and I will tell you what you wanted to see.”
tr-003: “You may ask me anything. I will answer truthfully. I will not answer the question you asked. Begin.”
tr-004: “Do not be afraid. I rarely bring bad news; I bring finished news. Tell me what you are ready to put down.”
tr-005: “We have been standing here for an hour. Neither of us wants to be the first to decide. You look neutral. Help us.”
tr-006: “Take the lantern, it is lighter than it looks. I only ask that you do not hurry. The mountain does not reward speed.”
tr-007: “Do not trust the shadows. Do not trust me either. Just keep walking and tell me what you see on the left.”
tr-008: “Come sit. The water is cold but it is clean. I will tell you the secret: nothing here is finished, and that is good.”
yk-001: “Pour the tea. Slowly. I am told you can read the court by what people leave unsaid. Do tell me what I am not saying.”
yk-002: “Come in from the storm. Do not worry about the cold; it is mine, and it will not follow you in. Tell me what you promised, and to whom.”
yk-003: “Do not bow. Do not apologise. If you came for the sword, put down the fear first. It is heavier.”
yk-004: “You bowed! Everyone should bow. Now I must bow back, so the water spills. A clever trap, was it not?”
yk-005: “Do be seated. The tea is not poisoned; that would be crude. Tell me, can you hear the third string? It is the one I tuned for you.”
yk-006: “Ah, a guest! Would you like tea? Rice cakes? A temple? I can supply all three, though only one is real.”
yk-007: “Drink. The sake is good and the company is honest. I will not hurt you; I do not hurt guests. Tell me who sent you.”
yk-008: “You are sitting in my sun. No, stay. I only wanted you to know it is mine. Now, did you bring fish, or only questions?”
